Who is Captain Stalfos?

Later on, the captain gets possessed by from the , and must calm him down in order to continue on his journey. To do this, he must go to the , surround the captain by pushing barrels of explosives around him, and then detonating them. If is successful, the crew of will give him an , which can be played near one of ten pirate to unlock it.
